gates.evidence: On the upper front robe panel near image (505,655), and on the lap near (140,1090) and (287,1145), each complete motif is one yellow disc above two yellow discs: exactly three in a triangular cluster. All are visible together in the original 1096x1436 frame.

At least three complete clusters repeat across the same magenta robe body, including upper torso and two separated lap areas; the sleeve also carries another cluster but is not needed to substitute for body coverage.
Yellow disc clusters lie flush on the magenta textile, whose folds and woven sheen continue around the motif edges. The upper torso and lap provide visible robe-body carrier surfaces.

The disc shapes read as flat cloth-surface motifs with internal stitched texture. They are distinct from the separately rendered neckline jewelry, ring, waist clasp and hanging earring; no floating token or button stands in for the motif.

claim_limit: This image supports only the bounded magenta-robe/yellow-three-disc-repetition/cloth-layer realization. It does not qualify the full prior H01 compound, Ottoman historical authenticity, identity, rank or native source facts.
